title: Mastery of Fear
summary: Use fear to control susceptible enemies while defeating the fearless attackers.
overview: Use fear to control susceptible enemies while defeating the fearless attackers.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Begin only when everyone is ready for the fifteen-minute trial.
Keep fear on susceptible enemies; the script drains their health while they are feared.
Defeat at least fifteen of the fearless enemies before the timer expires.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
